text:
sophia (marketing): We're running an interactive roundtable + hands-on lab next Thu. Need owners for reg page, breakout labs, Zoom studio flow, per-lab capture, and post-event routing. Can we lock today?

liam (events): I'll run Zoom + pre-show. Plan: require registration (auto-approve), waiting room T-10, pre-assigned breakout rooms, alt hosts set. Need final reg fields and producer alt host.

nora (producer): I can own capture and edits. Request: separate raw files per lab, isolated mic tracks where possible, local SSD backup + scripted upload to S3. Will provide ingest keys in 1Password.

sophia (marketing): Reg page fields: first name, last name, email, company, role, timezone, preferred_lab (dropdown), recording_consent (yes/no), publish_pref (public/internal/no). Hidden utm params and a one-line use-case field.

devin (growth): HubSpot mapping: campaign=roundtable-june, source=webinar, map preferred_lab -> `lab_interest`, publish_pref -> `webinar_publish_pref`. Zapier should tag country and timezone and exclude publish_pref=no from public lists.

liam (events): Zoom checklist: cloud recording ON, record breakouts separately (enable per-session recording), auto-transcribe, disable in-meeting file transfers, chat host-only during main session. OBS RTMP fallback available; alt hosts: nora + sophia.

nora (producer): Naming convention: `roundtable_{YYYYMMDD}_{lab}_{raw|edit}.{ext}` e.g. `roundtable_20260610_labA_raw.mp4`. Transcripts: same base + `.vtt` and `.txt`. I'll output a 45s social cut + 30s paid variants.

sophia (marketing): Post-event cadence: Day0 private replay + calendar, Day2 lab-specific clip + CTA to trial, Day5 full replay + transcript (public if publish_pref=public). Who drafts Day2?

devin (growth): I'll draft Day2 and paid social copy. Nora, can you deliver 45s + 30s + 15s cuts within 24h? Also need HLS preview for paid channels.

nora (producer): Yes. I will upload raw files within 6h, a 2-min highlights and 45s social within 24h, and captions `.vtt` + plain `.txt`. Will also create a captions-burned 15s for paid.

liam (events): Ops checklist I'll pin: 1) Reg page live + test registrant, 2) Zoom meeting created + alt hosts, 3) Producer local backup confirmed, 4) Zapier -> HubSpot mapping validated, 5) Pre-show run T-20, 6) Asset handoff & consent filter.

sophia (marketing): Note: include `recording_consent` in webhook payload so we can automatically filter non-consent registrants from public assets and paid audiences. Also remind speakers to avoid PII in chat.

zoom-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Redwood Interactive Roundtable & Labs" Thu 2026-06-10 17:00 UTC. Recording: cloud enabled.
